g.text: A PV roof is a slightly different colour, not a different object

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5540

g.text: to the same roof-size mix. The gap is a few percent of reflectance -- darkest through red and near-infrared,

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5540

g.text: smallest in blue and SWIR -- which is a statistical signal, never a per-roof proof
